limitations: Limitations: No identified author implementation in frozen bounded-discovery record; separate attachment inaccessible.
Limitations: No author programs or experiments run; raw returns/configs/checkpoints unavailable.
Limitations: Figure curves compared visually, not digitized; illustrative independent-normal difference intervals are not paired hypothesis tests.
P1 — Counterevidence: Rounding explains small other-cell differences but not a tenfold PP8 discrepancy. All six point-estimate rankings survive the correction.

P2 — Counterevidence: A stale diagram or prose configuration can explain PP without corrupting numerical trials; a selected early checkpoint/other evaluation can explain the table value. Neither alternative is identified, but neither is excluded by the source. The original report treated absent correspondence as demonstrated core-impact inconsistency.

P3 — Counterevidence: Network diagrams often omit output parameter transforms, and valid logits-based BCE/scale parameterization could have been used. Without code, actual invalid values or training failure are not established.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
